correctness.rationale: All-n proof: e_[a,b] imposes endpoints a<=u<=v<=b; its two tails contribute exactly L or 1 and R or 1, giving the weighted binomial count. A finite geometric summation yields A_n. Interval-clamp compositions commute exactly for overlapping images, and the one-dimensional Helly property proves the maximal subsemilattices and every clique coefficient. Direct enumeration checks n=1..10, including boundary cases; it does not stand in for the proof.

The 2021 source classifies the object and idempotents; the 2024 source supplies a presentation for the exactly equivalent monoid, but neither supplies the claimed centralizer sizes or the mixed commuting-pair and clique-polynomial formulas. Other relevant commuting-graph studies concern distinct monoids. Targeted publication and mathematical-record queries uncovered no statement implying the full theorem. Global priority remains unproved.
